Firo's ongoing paid vulnerability program covers reproducible issues in firoorg/firo master only. A working project-specific PoC and exact commit are required; known issues and third-party-only bugs are excluded. Disclose all AI assistance in any report; payouts are in FIRO.

Monero's published vulnerability response process offers XMR bounties for its repository code on master and release branches. Live networks and websites are excluded; reports require a working PoC and must disclose every use of AI or the bounty is forfeited.

Repository SECURITY.md explicitly routes mpc-lib findings to the paid Fireblocks MPC Bugcrowd program. SECURITY-MODEL.md limits eligible findings to exploitable library-internal failures affecting an honest MPC participant; integrator storage, transport, authorization, invalid caller inputs, and test-only issues are excluded. For sanitizer findings, a working PoC showing unwanted behavior on x86_64 or aarch64 is required; sanitizer output alone is insufficient. Review the AI-assisted researcher notes before reporting.

Repository SECURITY.md explicitly places this C++ library in Valve HackerOne report scope, but bounty eligibility is limited to vulnerabilities in code actually used by Steam players. Demonstrate impact in Steamworks SDK or Valve games; stand-alone-library-only and third-party bundled-code findings may not qualify. Report privately through Valve HackerOne.
